## Contribution type

- [ ] New idea proposal under `submissions/<my-username>/...`
- [ ] Update to an official idea I own
- [ ] Delete an official idea I own
- [ ] Maintainer/platform change

## Originality

- [ ] I originated or have the right to submit the core idea.
- [ ] I performed a reasonable public literature/prior-art search.
- [ ] `metadata.yml` records search date, sources, queries, closest work, and differentiation.
- [ ] I am not aware of public academic work that already discloses the same core idea.

## AI use and validation

- [ ] AI-assisted roles are disclosed in `metadata.yml`.
- [ ] I checked that cited references are real.
- [ ] I did not represent fabricated or unexecuted results as real experiments.

## Rights and safety

- [ ] I have the right to publish these files.
- [ ] No secrets/credentials are included.
- [ ] No unauthorized confidential/private data are included.
